oldFailureMechanism: Original guard detects failed event accounting, requests stop, then helper imposes a separate 12-second wait followed by SIGKILL even during valid abort-result export. This return code does not erase the earlier EDGE rejection.
mechanismEvidence: Parent investigation plus archived ext4 helper stop(process) SIGINT/process.wait(timeout=12)/SIGKILL source; original result retained unchanged.

api.request_stop: request_stop(now_ns, grace_seconds=12) -> Decision; no process signal/kill
api.exportDeadline: receipt.drainedMonotonicNanos + min(configured_export_budget,60 seconds) once stop requested
api.finalize: Stopped runs cannot return COMPLETE; capacity_pass remains false for every Decision

testsCovered: Timely drain followed by 26-second abort export; delayed receipt observation does not invalidate its verified drain time.
No receipt at stop+12 seconds expires at the next nanosecond, failure sticky.
Original activity deadline remains earlier if applicable.
Repeated stop cannot move either activity deadline or export origin.
Stopped run configured for 120-second export is capped at 60.
Failed HTTP can finish export but remains failed.
integration: Caller latches original user/monitor failure independently.
Caller sends SIGTERM once and then keeps polling observe with actual monotonic time and process returncode.
Caller kills only on lifecycle FAILED/real deadline, not a separate fixed 12-second helper while EXPORTING.
Full JSON parsing/finalize stays within export deadline.
Receipt requires current runId/label/PID/startTicks, monotonic time, completed workers and conservation.
limits: Only pure state-machine tests performed; no native generator/process/signal/service/network/pressure run.
A valid receipt observed after the stop deadline can prove earlier timely drain; once a no-receipt timeout has been observed, failure is sticky and cannot be rescued.
No new capacity PASS or rewrite of the old failed run.
No .work stage, ext4 helper or production Lua edits.

validationStatus: 18 pure tests passed by source receipt (10 prior +8 new, not 28); real-process subsequent-run verification is outside this archive.
